1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not chemically disrupt the embryo axis or scutellum__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a method other than cell wall disruption using enzymes or gentle sonication__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the agitation is performed for a duration of less than one hour__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a method other than cell wall degrading enzymes or gentle sonication__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and performing magnetic separation without enzymatic treatment__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __that are not subjected to cell wall degrading enzyme treatment prior to molecular analysis__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent condition__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed without prior enzymatic cell wall disruption__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __and is performed on DNA extracted without enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein the phenotyping is correlated with the genotype determined in step (c)__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on DNA obtained without enzymatic cell wall degradation__.
